- Found in Living Memory: direct HTTP verified 2026-08-27; auth/catalog rechecked 2026-09-09.
- Endpoint: `POST https://gigacode.ru/api/v2/chat/completions`, model `vllm/CodeChat` (“CodeAgent”), OpenAI-compatible.
- Discovery: `GET /api/v2/config` → `401` with `X-Authorization-Url: /api/v2/auth/plugin`; authenticated catalog is `chat.models`; `/api/v2/models` returns `404`.
- Auth: POST device metadata with `device_code` from `~/.gigacode/device_id`; receive Bearer JWT valid **600 seconds**. Cached `gigacode_token.json` may be expired.
- Verified: non-streaming, SSE streaming, function/tool calls; rapid requests can return plain-text `Too Many Requests` without retry headers.
- September config advertised context **262144**, `max_tokens=8192`, parallel tools; these were not verified hard limits. `/api/v2/responses` had an empty model catalog.
- Correction: `ai-llm-proxy…/gigachat/v1/chat/completions` is **GigaChat**, not proof of GigaCode access; its `INTERNAL_TOKEN` is separate.
- DeepSeek Flash identity was unconfirmed hearsay; observed `reasoning_content=null`. CLI **26.7.33** exposed no GigaCode thinking/effort control; bundled Anthropic thinking code was unrelated.
